sqlMap.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT GL.A01_ACCNO AS ACCNO, GL.A01_ACCSEQ AS ACCSEQ, 'C' AS STATUS FROM ERPFM..TACCOUNT GL WHERE 1 = 1 AND ( GL.CREATE_DATE >= DATEADD(DD,-2, GETDATE()) OR GL.UPDATE_DATE >= DATEADD(DD,-2, GETDATE()) ) AND A01_ACODE IN ( '1114805', '2112605') UNION ALL SELECT HS.X01_ACCNO AS ACCNO, HS.X01_ACCSEQ AS ACCSEQ, 'D' AS STATUS FROM ERPFM..TACCOUNT_HIS HS WHERE 1 = 1 AND HS.UPDATE_DATE >= DATEADD(DD,-6, GETDATE()) AND HS.X01_ACODE IN ( '1114805', '2112605') AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 'X' FROM ERPFM..TACCOUNT WHERE A01_ACCNO = HS.X01_ACCNO AND A01_ACCSEQ = HS.X01_ACCSEQ AND A01_ACODE IN ( '1114805', '2112605') ) ) A ORDER BY A.ACCNO, A.ACCSEQ, A.STATUS

SELECT A01_ACCNO AS ACCNO, A01_ACCSEQ AS ACCSEQ, CASE WHEN GL.UPDATE_DATE IS NULL THEN 'C' ELSE 'R' END AS STATUS, A01_GL_DATE AS GL_DATE, A01_CURRENCY AS CURRENCY, CASE WHEN A01_DRCR = '1' THEN A01_AMOUNT ELSE NULL END AS DEBIT, CASE WHEN A01_DRCR = '2' THEN A01_AMOUNT ELSE NULL END AS CREDIT, A01_ACODE AS ACODE, A01_SAUPJ AS SAUPJ, (SELECT TOP 1 ISNULL(C.A02_ACODENM , '' ) FROM ERPFM..TACODE C WHERE C.A02_ACODE = GL.A01_ACODE ) AS ACODENM, A01_REMARK AS REMARK, A01_REGNO AS A01_REGNO, A01_CUSTOMERNM AS A01_CUSTOMERNM, (SELECT TOP 1 A01_DEPARTCODE FROM ERPFM..TACCOUNT WHERE A01_ACCNO= GL.A01_ACCNO AND A01_DRCR ='1' ) AS A01_CCODE, (SELECT TOP 1 CT.CT01_NAME FROM ERPFM..TCTCCC AS CT WHERE CT .CT01_CC = (SELECT TOP 1 A01_DEPARTCODE FROM ERPFM..TACCOUNT WHERE A01_ACCNO= GL.A01_ACCNO AND A01_DRCR ='1' )) AS CT01_NAME , A01_REFNO1 AS REFNO1, A01_REFNO2 AS REFNO2, A01_ISSUE_DATE AS ISSUE_DATE, A01_DUE_DATE AS DUE_DATE, A01_BANK + ' ' + A01_BANKNM AS BANK, A01_QUANTITY AS QUANTITY, A01_ITEM_UNIT AS ITEM_UNIT, A01_PRICE AS PRICE, A01_ITEM AS ITEM, A01_FINA_CLASS AS FINA_CLASS, A01_WHOUT_TYPE AS WHOUT_TYPE, A01_PRIN_AMOUNT AS PRIN_AMOUNT, A01_RATE AS RATE, A01_REFNO5 AS A01_REFNO5, A01_ATTRIBUTE2 AS A01_ATTRIBUTE2, A01_REFNO3 AS REFNO3, A01_REFNO4 AS REFNO4, A01_APPROVE_STATUS AS APPROVE_STATUS , A01_APPROVE_EMPLOYEE AS APPROVE_EMPLOYEE, convert (CHAR(8),A01_APPROVE_DATE, 112 ) AS APPROVE_DATE, A01_ENTRY_DATE AS ENTRY_DATE, CONVERT( CHAR(8) ,GL.CREATE_DATE , 112 ) AS CREATE_DATE, A01_REFNO10 AS REFNO10, A01_EMPLOYEE AS EMPLOYEE, A01_STATUS AS A01_STATUS, A01_APPROVE_STATUS AS A01_APPROVE_STATUS, 1 AS SEQ FROM ERPFM..TACCOUNT GL WHERE 1 = 1 AND GL.A01_ACCNO = #ACCNO# AND GL.A01_ACCSEQ = #ACCSEQ# AND GL.A01_ACODE IN ( '1114805', '2112605')

SELECT X01_ACCNO AS ACCNO, X01_ACCSEQ AS ACCSEQ, 'D' AS STATUS, '' AS GL_DATE, X01_CURRENCY AS CURRENCY, CASE WHEN X01_DRCR = '1' THEN X01_AMOUNT ELSE NULL END AS DEBIT, CASE WHEN X01_DRCR = '2' THEN X01_AMOUNT ELSE NULL END AS CREDIT, X01_ACODE AS ACODE, '' AS SAUPJ, (SELECT TOP 1 ISNULL(C.A02_ACODENM, '' ) FROM ERPFM..TACODE C WHERE C.A02_ACODE = HS.X01_ACODE ) AS ACODENM, X01_REMARK AS REMARK, X01_REGNO AS A01_REGNO, X01_CUSTOMERNM AS A01_CUSTOMERNM, X01_CCODE AS A01_CCODE, (SELECT TOP 1 CT.CT01_NAME FROM ERPFM..TCTCCC AS CT WHERE CT.CT01_CC = (SELECT TOP 1 A01_DEPARTCODE FROM ERPFM..TACCOUNT WHERE A01_ACCNO= HS.X01_ACCNO AND A01_DRCR ='1' )) AS CT01_NAME, X01_REFNO1 AS REFNO1, X01_REFNO2 AS REFNO2, X01_ISSUE_DATE AS ISSUE_DATE, X01_DUE_DATE AS DUE_DATE, X01_BANK + ' ' + X01_BANKNM AS BANK, X01_QUANTITY AS QUANTITY, X01_ITEM_UNIT AS ITEM_UNIT, X01_PRICE AS PRICE, X01_ITEM AS ITEM, X01_FINA_CLASS AS FINA_CLASS, X01_WHOUT_TYPE AS WHOUT_TYPE, X01_PRIN_AMOUNT AS PRIN_AMOUNT, X01_RATE AS RATE, X01_REFNO5 AS A01_REFNO5, X01_ATTRIBUTE2 AS A01_ATTRIBUTE2, X01_REFNO3 AS REFNO3, X01_REFNO4 AS REFNO4, X01_APPROVE_STATUS AS APPROVE_STATUS, X01_APPROVE_EMPLOYEE AS APPROVE_EMPLOYEE, convert (CHAR(8),X01_APPROVE_DATE, 112 ) AS APPROVE_DATE, X01_ENTRY_DATE AS ENTRY_DATE, convert (CHAR(8),CREATE_DATE, 112 ) AS CREATE_DATE, X01_REFNO10 AS REFNO10, X01_EMPLOYEE AS EMPLOYEE, X01_STATUS AS A01_STATUS, X01_APPROVE_STATUS AS A01_APPROVE_STATUS, 2 AS SEQ FROM ERPFM..TACCOUNT_HIS HS WHERE 1 = 1 AND X01_ACCNO = #ACCNO# AND X01_ACCSEQ = #ACCSEQ# AND X01_ACODE IN ( '1114805', '2112605')
